##### Project general facts

AWWA Hotel is a concept-driven boutique hospitality project designed as a fully completed and operational income-generating complex in the heart of Canggu. Officially commissioned in the third quarter of 2025, the property represents a modern approach to hospitality investment, combining contemporary design, strong branding, and professional in-house management. Developed with a focus on lifestyle, wellness, and long-term profitability, the project offers stylish one-bedroom apartments with an efficient layout of over 33 m² and an attractive investment model with projected returns of up to 12% ROI. With occupancy levels expected to start from around 80% and transparent operational reporting provided through a dedicated CRM system, the complex demonstrates both reliability and strong potential in Bali’s thriving tourism market.

The hotel stands out for its thoughtfully curated amenities designed to create an exceptional guest experience. At the center of the property is a stunning 25-meter signature swimming pool that doubles as a visual landmark and social hub, enhanced by exclusive artwork from internationally renowned artist Shira Barzilay (Koketit). The rooftop open-air cinema offers a unique entertainment experience under the tropical sky, while an elegant on-site bar creates a relaxed yet sophisticated atmosphere for social gatherings. The adults-only concept ensures a tranquil and refined environment, complemented by wellness-oriented features such as dedicated yoga spaces. Guests also benefit from a full range of premium services, including a 24/7 concierge, professional property maintenance, and attentive hospitality standards that elevate the entire stay into a seamless luxury lifestyle experience.

Each residence within the project is designed to reflect modern elegance and comfort while maintaining a strong connection to Bali’s natural surroundings. Interiors feature refined contemporary finishes, spacious layouts, and large windows that overlook either the iconic pool or the lush tropical landscape. The rooms include private bathrooms, comfortable work areas with desks, and stylish round dining tables that enhance both functionality and aesthetic appeal. A fully equipped kitchenette in every apartment allows guests to enjoy the convenience of independent living while maintaining the comforts of a hotel environment. The combination of carefully selected furniture, sophisticated décor, and eco-conscious design principles creates an atmosphere that is both luxurious and relaxed, perfectly suited for long stays, remote work, and premium holiday experiences.

##### Parking 
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Located on the southwestern coast of Canggu, the area has become one of Bali’s most vibrant and sought-after lifestyle destinations. Known for its laid-back atmosphere combined with contemporary sophistication, it attracts travelers, entrepreneurs, and digital nomads from around the world. The coastline is famous for its scenic beaches, legendary surf breaks, and breathtaking sunsets that create a unique coastal ambiance throughout the year.

The district is also celebrated for its dynamic social and culinary scene. Trendy cafés, fine dining restaurants, boutique shops, and internationally renowned beach clubs form an energetic cultural hub that blends tropical charm with modern lifestyle trends. The area’s popularity among global travelers ensures a steady flow of visitors, making it one of the most active hospitality and leisure markets in Bali.

In addition to its vibrant atmosphere, the location offers excellent connectivity and infrastructure. Easy access to beaches, wellness studios, yoga centers, and entertainment venues allows visitors to enjoy a balanced lifestyle focused on relaxation, health, and recreation. Continuous development and the area’s strong global reputation have established it as one of the island’s most desirable coastal destinations for both leisure and long-term stays.
